CREATE TABLE stations (
    station_id text PRIMARY KEY,
    harbour text
);

First 2 rows:
station_id  harbour
TG-7        North Quay
TG-9        Salt Point

CREATE TABLE readings (
    station_id text REFERENCES stations (station_id),
    read_at timestamp,
    level_cm numeric
);

First 2 rows:
station_id  read_at              level_cm
TG-7        2026-03-01 06:00:00  212.4
TG-9        2026-03-01 06:00:00  198.0
